optimizer_switches.name: index_condition_pushdown
optimizer_switches.explanation: Parts of the WHERE clause are evaluated inside the storage engine using index columns before fetching the full row — reduces rows handed to the server layer.

executive_summary: Query runs 6 operators; returns 50 rows in 0.18 ms. No warnings.

query.raw: /* select#1 */ select `u`.`name` AS `name`,`o`.`id` AS `id`,`oi`.`product_id` AS `product_id` from `testdb`.`users` `u` join `testdb`.`orders` `o` join `testdb`.`order_items` `oi` where ((`o`.`user_id` = `u`.`id`) and (`oi`.`order_id` = `o`.`id`) and (`u`.`country` = 'JP')) limit 50
query.beautified:
select u.name AS name,o.id AS id,oi.product_id AS product_id
from testdb.users u
  join testdb.orders o
  join testdb.order_items oi
where ((o.user_id = u.id) and (oi.order_id = o.id) and (u.country = 'JP'))
limit 50
